system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: It reads the project's own `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md` plus a global one you set once, runs a lean coding prompt
system_prompt_style.note: README only; source is closed. Also LLM Profiles tune prompt size per model and privacy mode changes prompt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: a repo map so it heads straight to the right file in a large codebase, `@` to point at a file by name
env_context_strategy.note: Repo map injected plus Read/Grep tools in Code window; inferred from README prose.

context_compaction.note: README does not describe history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: with semantic element detection through the accessibility tree
observation_format.evidence_locator: README.md (What you can ask it to do)@ea49c47
observation_format.note: Computer Use: 'the screenshots appear inline in chat'.

tool_call_format.note: README mentions LLM Profiles tuning tool calls but not the call syntax.

tool_count.note: README claims '260+ tools' overall; default exposed count not stated.

edit_primitive.note: An 'Edit' step exists but its primitive is not described.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Skales also speaks Agent2Agent, so another agent can discover this instance and delegate to it.
protocol_standardization.evidence_locator: README.md (What you can ask it to do)@ea49c47
protocol_standardization.note: MCP: 'Add MCP servers for anything else.'

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: ReAct agent loop, 260+ tools, multi-agent delegation, per-turn tool budgeting
loop_primitives.note: /goal mode plans then runs steps (plan_execute-like) and scheduled tasks exist; not coded as mechanism is undocumented.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: **Goals** shows what each one is trying to do, the criteria it must meet and the evidence it has collected
planning_granularity.note: Goal objects with criteria plus Kanban tasks; inferred from prose.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: ReAct agent loop, 260+ tools, multi-agent delegation, per-turn tool budgeting
multi_agent_topology.note: Default chat is one agent; Organization (CEO routing, hierarchical), parallel sub-agents in Code, swarm, Group Chat reachable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Parallel sub-agents show in a rail with live token and tool-call counts and a Stop all.
delegation_mechanism.note: Also A2A delegation and /swarm to paired devices.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **Code** asks before each edit, **Edits** approves file edits as it goes but still asks before a shell command or a push, **Auto** runs the whole task after a one-time consent.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: A goal is only finished when its own success criteria are met, and what it learned folds back into Memory.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Short-term and long-term memory, identity maintenance, and a three-phase overnight consolidation engine (Dreaming) that promotes what matters and discards noise
long_term_memory.note: Obsidian vaults, Agent Skills SKILL.md import, local embedding history search.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Reopen the app and it picks up where it left off.

self_verification.note: Lio AI uses a reviewing AI; not the default harness.

rollback.evidence_quote: one-click Undo per file or for a whole turn
rollback.note: Git diffs also shown; mechanism unspecified.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: it stops when the task is done, when it genuinely needs a decision, or before a consequential action like sending an email

cost_controls.evidence_quote: a per-model profile that tunes the tool budget, prompt size and a short per-model hint
cost_controls.note: Tool-call budget rather than monetary cap.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: It sits on your machine, has access to your files, your browser, your calendar, your email, and it does real work.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Computer Use takes screenshots, clicks, types and scrolls, with approval on every action in Safety Mode
permission_model.evidence_locator: README.md (What you can ask it to do)@ea49c47
permission_model.note: Code mode asks before each edit; always-allow available.

tracing.evidence_quote: its last steps with the tool each used, what it produced, what it learned, what it spent

replayability.evidence_quote: a repeatable run can be recorded as a **Playbook** and replayed later.
replayability.evidence_locator: README.md (What you can ask it to do)@ea49c47

guardrails.evidence_quote: every plugin runs against an explicit tool list, locked to its own folder, and anything that leaves the machine still asks first.
guardrails.note: Output filter: Watermark removal (off by default) and Privacy Mode.

target_domain.evidence_quote: coding (Skales Code), desktop + browser automation, autonomous scheduled Tasks

open_source.evidence_quote: Skales itself is closed source under BSL 1.1
open_source.note: Repo holds historical v7 snapshot only; BSL is not OSI.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: No vendor lock-in. Bring your own key, or run locally for free.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This is where Skales is *distributed*: releases,
primary_artifact.note: Only README/marketing docs available; product source closed.
